request: Compare the fish heads closely with the supplied target and polish their sculpt.
route: deterministic img2threejs fish-head reconstruction followed by real Chromium multi-view validation, source GLB export, Blender optimization and close render, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild
rootCause: The previous fish module was assembled from a scaled sphere and long cylindrical nozzle, so it read as a puffer or pipe rather than the target's compact sculpted fish mask.
changes: replaced the spherical head with a custom closed six-section elliptical cranium that tapers from skull and cheeks into the muzzle root
removed the long cylindrical snout and rebuilt the outlet as short puckered lips around a dark mouth cavity
added a broad muzzle pad and separate lower jaw
enlarged and repositioned side-set eyes, pupils, and shallow orbital brow ridges
strengthened gill plates, side fins, and the paired dorsal crest silhouette
made every water stream originate from the transformed position of its named fish-mouth socket
limitations: The deterministic primitive sculpt is slightly cleaner and more symmetrical than the softly hand-modeled fish heads in the painted target.
Vertical wall and upper-bowl seams remain separate embedded solids rather than destructive mortar cuts.
Water jets and impacts remain runtime or review effects excluded from structural GLB and FBX geometry.
Android device performance and final user art-direction approval remain pending.
